description: List what people asked for in your meetings (features, integrations, deliverables, pricing, fixes), rolled up by theme across meetings, most asked first. Each theme gives how many asked, who, which companies, when it was first and last asked, and the words each person said. Filter by person, company, kind, date range or theme.

company.description: A company: what people there asked for

from.description: Earliest meeting date, YYYY-MM-DD (a UTC day)

person.description: A person's ID or name: what they asked for

theme.description: A theme's ID or name, e.g. 'Salesforce export'

to.description: Latest meeting date, YYYY-MM-DD (a UTC day)

name: list_asks
